Title: Generally available: Logic Apps Standard Support for Functions Runtime V4

Body.Content:
Logic apps Standard support for Azure Functions runtime version 4.x – is now generally available.

Between 17 and 31 October 2024, an update that will default the creation of new Logic Apps Standard App instances using Azure Functions V4 is being rolled out.

Between 1 and 31 November 2024, existing Logic App Standard instances will be migrated automatically to Azure Functions V4, unless they have been deployed using the nuget method or have changed its configuration to pin a specific version of the extension bundle.

For those cases, follow this guide to update your configuration.

Azure Functions version 3.x will be out of support from December 3 2022.

Recommended action

If you require a manual update to Functions V4 follow this guidance and update before January 31 2023.
